name: sub-human-repo
description: Dev scripts for the sub-human Claude Code plugin (the plugin has no dependencies; typescript, @types/node and oxlint only check its types and lint it).

scripts.test: npm run --silent typecheck && npm run --silent test:plugin && npm run --silent test:scripts && npm run --silent test:mods
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && node scripts/typecheck-shim.ts
